maria: Heads-up: after today's release I'm seeing a p95 decode latency jump on prod dedicated nodes — ~+18% on long-seq workloads. Repro in perf canary.
ashok: Which canary/CI measured this? any graphs?
maria: Canary failed: deploy-bot posted perf alert: `decode_p95 increased 18% (seq_len=1024)` on pool-rw-dedicated-4.
ci-bot: CI perf check failed on PR #3124 — benchmark `decode_longseq`: baseline 44ms -> 52ms (+18%).
taylor: Do we have a suspect commit? should we rollback the merge?
maria: Merge commit is abc1234 (PR 3124) — it touched fused-op kernel selector & batching heuristics.
jordana: Ran a minimal reproducer and profiled with nvprof. Selector is falling back to attn_generic_cuda instead of attn_fused_bfloat16_v3 for a large fraction of steps.
jordana: nvprof snippet:
```
Kernel: attn_fused_bfloat16_v3  | calls: 1200 | time: 520ms
Kernel: attn_generic_cuda       | calls: 5400 | time: 2300ms
Top hotspot: attn_generic_cuda
```
maria: That maps to the new entropy heuristic in the autoselector — sequences with repeated EOS/sep tokens spike the computed entropy and cause a fallback.
ashok: The selector change was intended to avoid correctness regressions for edge-case layouts, but it seems the threshold is too aggressive.
taylor: Can we bisect to confirm?
jordana: git bisect narrowed it to abc1234. Replacing the new heuristic restores pre-merge latencies on the reproducer.
infra-bot: Canary rollback scheduled for pool-rw-dedicated-4 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ashok: Quick patch to revert the threshold tweak (selector threshold 0.55 -> 0.7). Deploying to canary now. Patch:
```
diff --git a/runtime/kernel_selector.py b/runtime/kernel_selector.py
-    if entropy_score > 0.55:
+    if entropy_score > 0.7:
         choose_generic()
```
maria: Canary after 10m: p95 returned to baseline for seq_len=1024 workloads :thumbsup:
taylor: Postmortem items: add unit tests for selector entropy edgecases, add CI perf guardrail to fail on >10% decode_p95 regression, and add telemetry for per-request kernel choice.
jordana: I'll add a tiny repro script and a flamegraph job; also propose logging `kernel_name` in request traces for 24h.
maria: Opening an issue with reproducer, bisect output, and perf artifacts — https://redwood/issue/INF-2198
maria: Thanks everyone — leaving notes in the release PR and tagging owners for follow-ups.
